## ✨ Highlights

- 🔒 **Go 1.27.3 for every Janus binary**: Go's `crypto/x509` now refuses a set of intermediate certificates known to be compromised ([CVE-2026-111943](https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-6809)). Everything that verifies a certificate chain - a node checking its Controller, a log target, Let's Encrypt or a `seedfrom` server; janusctl and the Controller checking a node; the Controller's updater, the site, the node_exporter extension, the Terraform provider - is rebuilt with it.
- 🖥️ **The screen-only image, usable**: the release's catalog now offers the console choice, so the image factory builds `"console": "screen"` schematics; and a screen-only node shows each line of its console once.

## 🔒 Security

For every node, janusctl, the Controller and its updater, the site, the Terraform provider, and nodes with the **prometheus-node-exporter** extension:

- **Go 1.27.3** (was 1.27.2), the standard library it builds in:
  - [CVE-2026-111943](https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-6809) (`crypto/x509`): `Certificate.Verify` now fails a chain through one of the intermediate certificates no longer considered trustworthy, a denylist for the cases where a system trust store isn't updated. Janus's own PKI is untouched by it - its CAs are its own -; what it protects is every verification against the system store (a `seedfrom` or upgrade server over https, a log target trusted through the node's trust store, Let's Encrypt).

Nothing else changes in those binaries.

## 🏭 Image factory

- **The console choice is in the catalog** ([#205](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/205)): v2026.10.20-3's `schematic-catalog.json` listed no `console`, so the image factory refused the screen-only schematic for it - the catalog was assembled field by field and the new one left out. It is now taken whole from the variants, and a test keeps it so.

## ⚙️ Node

- **A screen-only node's console, once** ([#206](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/206)): `init` copies what the console shows to the screen as well as to the serial port - for the operator in front of a monitor. On an image whose console is the screen alone, that copy showed every line twice. `init` now mirrors only when the kernel's console is a serial port; the serial images are as before.

## 🧪 Tests and tooling

- [v2026.10.20-3's lab campaign](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/blob/main/docs/pre-release-tests/v2026.10.20-3.md): the console's share under load on a real node - `init` 2.46 % of a core with the default share, **0.05 %** at 0, back at the default again - and a screen-only node made by hand: nothing on its serial port, registered through the Controller, `init` 0.02 % under 65,000 logged requests a second.

## ⚠️ Upgrade notes

- **Nodes**: the usual A/B update. A node that verifies a server through the system trust store - a `seedfrom` or upgrade URL over https, a log target trusted through the node's trust store (the default), Let's Encrypt - would refuse one whose chain goes through a denylisted intermediate: a sign of a problem there, not here.
- **The Controller**, **janusctl**, **the Terraform provider**: rebuilt with Go 1.27.3, nothing else changed; update them with the nodes.
- **Schematics**: `"console": "screen"` builds for this release on.
